title: a method's symbol id is dereferenced as an mrb_irep pointer where aliases are not handled
live_proof: upstream fixed it in d8911416c (d8911416c1e6730215fae1d111174e5da82dde9e) (2026-06-04), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: a report my first pattern missed (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: a report my first pattern missed); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it
status: sysalloc-none, sysalloc-bounds and sublet-gc measured 2026-10-06 on the Capstone application VM; cheribsd-revocation measured 2026-10-06 on CheriBSD purecap with libc revocation at its default

ignore.why: type-confusion, so the study measures spatial and temporal memory safety, and this defect is neither: it is kept because it is what the arms actually reported on the release, and dropping it would hide a reading that was taken
